newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Pampa Calichera signs $50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Pampa Calichera signs $50 mln loan.

text.p: Chile's Inversiones Pampa Calichera said it has signed a $50 million syndicated loan with five banks including Santander Investment Bank Ltd to refinance its short-term loans.
Pampa Calichera is an investment company associated with fertilizer-maker Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile SA (Soquimich).

Other banks involved in the loan included Banco Exterior (Suiza) SA, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, the Panama branch of Societe General and the Royal Bank of Canada, said the statement to the Chilean SEC.
